import Intro from '@site/src/components/Intro'

<Intro>
Compare every lock-owned file on disk against its recorded `vendor.lock.yaml` receipt. Report
drift — missing files, or files whose contents no longer match what was last vendored. Exits
non-zero when any drift is found, for use in CI.
</Intro>

## Usage

```shell
atmos vendor verify [--component <name> | --tags <a,b> | --stack <stack> [--labels <k>=<v>]] [--format table|json]
```

This never checks for a newer version upstream — see
<a href="/cli/commands/vendor/update">`atmos vendor update --check`</a> for that. The `vendor
verify` command is purely a read-only, on-disk integrity check against what's already recorded in
the lock file: it never fetches, writes, or modifies anything.

At most one selector may be given: `--component`, `--tags` (vendor.yaml's own declared source
tags), or `--stack`/`--labels` (a stack-resolved component set, composable with each other, like
<a href="/cli/commands/vendor/pull">`atmos vendor pull`</a>'s own `--stack`/`--labels`). Omit every
selector to verify everything. A selector that matches nothing is an error, not a silent
"verify everything" fallback.

## Examples

```shell
# Verify every vendored artifact.
atmos vendor verify

# Verify only one component.
atmos vendor verify --component vpc

# Verify every component whose vendor.yaml source declares a given tag.
atmos vendor verify --tags networking

# Verify every component in a stack, or matching stack metadata.labels.
atmos vendor verify --stack dev-us-west-2
atmos vendor verify --labels tier=1

# Machine-readable output for CI.
atmos vendor verify --format json
```

## Flags

<dl>
  <dt>`--component` / `-c` (string)</dt>
  <dd>Verify only this component. Mutually exclusive with `--tags` and `--stack`/`--labels`. Omit every selector to verify every artifact recorded in the lock file.</dd>
  <dt>`--tags` (string)</dt>
  <dd>Verify only components whose `vendor.yaml` source declares any of these comma-separated tags (matches any). Mutually exclusive with `--component` and `--stack`/`--labels`.</dd>
  <dt>`--stack` / `-s` (string)</dt>
  <dd>Verify only components belonging to the specified stack. Composes with `--labels` to narrow further. Mutually exclusive with `--component` and `--tags`.</dd>
  <dt>`--labels` (string)</dt>
  <dd>Verify only components whose stack `metadata.labels` match ALL of these comma-separated `key=value` or `key:value` pairs. Composes with `--stack`. Mutually exclusive with `--component` and `--tags`.</dd>
  <dt>`--format` (string, default `table`)</dt>
  <dd>Output format: `table` or `json`.</dd>
</dl>

:::note
The `atmos vendor verify` command reports drift; it never fixes it. Re-run
`atmos vendor pull --refresh-lock` (or `atmos vendor pull --component <name> --refresh-lock` for a
single component) to re-fetch and reconcile drifted sources. Or run
<a href="/cli/commands/vendor/vendor-clean">`atmos vendor clean`</a> to remove lock-owned files
outright.
:::
